journey.title: Dismiss suggestions with Escape while editing a saved city
journey.goal: Escape closes the suggestion list and keeps the city the user typed

functionalJourney.title: Pick a suggested city with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Typing part of a name and clicking a suggestion saves that city

guards.title: ArrowDown and Enter still select a suggestion
guards.goal: Typing Fa, ArrowDown and Enter saves Faro

attempts.failure: No number after minus sign in JSON at position 1637 (line 21 column 6)

plan.root_cause: The Escape key handler in listController.js incorrectly clears the input value and emits a 'clear' event, contrary to APG guidance that Escape should only close the suggestion list without modifying the input value.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the Escape case in the navigate function to only close the list, removing the input value clearing and the 'clear' event emission.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can dismiss the suggestion list with Escape while preserving their typed input, consistent with WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and ARIA APG combobox pattern.
functional_risks: Existing integrations listening for the 'clear' event on Escape may no longer receive it. However, the 'clear' event is not documented in the public API and its removal aligns with standard combobox behavior.
verification_requirements: The existing journey test (Escape press) should now pass, asserting that the list closes, focus remains on the input, and form data reflects the typed value.
Ensure ArrowDown and Enter selection still works (regression guard).

Best alignment: before lines 5-34 match file lines 230-259, then before line 35 "eventEmitter('clear', ctx);" differs from file line 260 "". The real file lines are in actual_source_region.
